traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The couatl's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:

At will: detect evil and good, detect magic, detect thoughts
3/day each: bless, create food and water, cure wounds, lesser restoration, protection from poison, sanctuary, shield
1/day each: dream, greater restoration, scrying

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The couatl's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Shielded Mind
traits.description: The couatl is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description:
The couatl magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).
In a new form, the couatl retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and other actions are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. If the new form has a bite attack, the couatl can use its bite in that form.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: As a reaction when you are targeted by an attack, gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, flame strike, raise dead
1/day each: commune, control weather, insect plague

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The planetar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened
traits.description: Immune to: charmed, exhaustion, frightened.

traits.name: Angelic Weapons
traits.description: The solar's weapon attacks are magical. When the solar hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 6d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The solar's spell casting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect evil and good, invisibility (self only)
3/day each: blade barrier, dispel evil and good, resurrection
1/day each: commune, control weather

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The solar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Condition Immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Poisoned
traits.description: Immune to: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned.

traits.name: Slaying Longbow (not automated)
traits.description: If the target is a creature that has 190 hit points or fewer, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or die.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.description: The solar releases its greatsword to hover magically in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it. If the solar can see the sword, the solar can mentally command it as a bonus action to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack against a target or return to the solar's hands. If the hovering sword is targeted by any effect, the solar is considered to be holding it. The hovering sword falls if the solar dies.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The solar magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Searing Burst
actions.description: The solar emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10 -foot radius must make a DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Blinding Gaze
actions.description: The solar targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. If the target can see it, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until magic such as the lesser restoration spell removes the blindness.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the unicorn moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The unicorn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The unicorn can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

At will: detect evil and good, druidcraft, pass without trace
1/day each: calm emotions, dispel evil and good, entangle

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The unicorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The unicorn's weapon attacks are magical.

traits.name: Condition Immunities: Charmed, Paralyzed, Poisoned
traits.description: Immune to: charmed, paralyzed, poisoned.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The unicorn magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 ft. of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: The unicorn makes one attack with its hooves.

actions.name: Shimmering Shield
actions.description: The unicorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 ft. of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the unicorn's next turn.

actions.name: Heal Self
actions.description: The unicorn magically regains 11 (2d8 + 2) hit points.
